caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: Aerie is a native Google Drive client for Linux. This is its first launch.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Wait for Aerie's welcome screen to appear, then leave it on screen for a few seconds.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: Clicking "Connect Google Drive" starts Google's OAuth sign-in in the browser.
Google's consent screen for Aerie. The address bar shows Aerie's OAuth client ID.\NScope requested: drive.readonly — "See and download all your Google Drive files"
instruction (shown to you while recordin: In Chrome, choose the account. On the consent screen, check the language (bottom left) is English, scroll so the whole screen shows, pause 5 seconds, then click Continue/Allow.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: Access granted. Google returns the user to Aerie.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: When Chrome says you can close the tab, switch back to Aerie.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive.readonly: Aerie reads file metadata to build a local index of My Drive and shared drives.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Let Aerie index for a few seconds (the sidebar shows progress).

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive.readonly: browsing folders in My Drive.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Open a folder or two in My Drive.
Click a shared drive in the sidebar and open a folder in it (skip if the account has none).

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive.readonly: searching all files by name.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Press Ctrl+K and search for a file name.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive.readonly: downloading a file to this computer.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Select a file, press Ctrl+D (Download), and save it.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: Changing files needs more access. Aerie asks only when the user first makes a change.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Clear the search, go to My Drive, and press Ctrl+Shift+N (New folder). When Aerie asks to allow changes, confirm.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: Consent for changes. The address bar shows Aerie's OAuth client ID.\NScope requested: drive — "See, edit, create, and delete all of your Google Drive files"
instruction (shown to you while recordin: On the consent screen, check the language is English, pause 5 seconds, then click Continue/Allow.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive: creating a folder in Google Drive.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Back in Aerie, create a folder named "Aerie demo".
Open "Aerie demo" and drag a file in from Files (or press Ctrl+U).
Rename the uploaded file (F2), then move it (Ctrl+M) if you like.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive: moving an item to the trash, with undo. Aerie never deletes permanently.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Move the file to the trash (Delete), then click Undo on the message.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: drive: keeping a chosen folder in two-way sync with a folder on this computer.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: Open Sync in the sidebar, choose "Aerie demo" to sync, and let a pass finish.

caption (shown in the video; \N breaks a: The same changes, seen in Google Drive on the web.
instruction (shown to you while recordin: In Chrome, open drive.google.com and show the "Aerie demo" folder.
